answer: The opal index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the mesa queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1566 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ocean. A 60 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
